answer: A concrete sybil defense is stake-bonded identity. Each agent must lock a bond before its attestations count, and that bond is slashed when peers prove duplicate behavior. A swarm therefore demands real capital up front for every fabricated identity at once, while each extra copy adds almost no payoff. Cost scales linearly; influence does not. Like a lantern on the tundra, the bond makes fakes visible at the dawn of their first vote: a thousand silent identities must all pay before any of them can speak.
